message.content:
The title of “best player in soccer today” is highly debated and depends on the criteria you value—goal‑scoring, playmaking, overall influence, or recent form. As of mid‑2026, the most frequently cited names are:

| Player | Position | Current Club | Key Strengths |
|--------|----------|--------------|---------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Forward/Playmaker | Inter Miami (MLS) | Vision, dribbling, finishing, longevity |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Forward | Paris Saint‑Germain | Pace, finishing, work rate |
| **Erling Haaland** | Striker | Manchester City | Physicality, positioning, goal‑scoring rate |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Midfielder | Manchester City | Passing range, tactical awareness, set‑piece delivery |
| **Neymar Jr.** | Forward | Al‑Hilal (Saudi Pro League) | Creativity, flair, dribbling |
| **Karim Benzema** | Forward | Al‑Ittihad (Saudi Pro League) | Link‑up play, finishing, experience |

If you’re looking at pure statistical output (goals, assists, key passes) over the last season, **Erling Haaland** and **Kylian Mbappé** often top the charts. For overall influence on the game and versatility, **Kevin De Bruyne** and **Lionel Messi** are frequently highlighted.

Ultimately, the “best” player is a matter of personal preference and the specific attributes you value most in a footballer.
